name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
shortDescription: A pattern that grounds language-model responses in retrieved application data.
whatItIs: RAG retrieves relevant information before generation so responses can use specific source context.
howILearned: I learned RAG by building natural-language access to engagement and participation data.
howIUseIt: I use retrieval to connect user questions with relevant structured or indexed project data.
lessonsLearned: Retrieval quality and source structure often matter more than prompt complexity.

seo.title: RAG Skill and Project Experience
seo.description: How I use retrieval-augmented generation in projects.
